f1_approval_years: Drugs by year of first approval, coloured by split (351 drugs; 3 excluded drugs are not shown). Test-T, the temporal cohort, is every drug first approved in 2025 to 2026 (41 drugs). The buffer holds drugs in the same similarity cluster as a Test-T drug and is not used.
f2_similarity_vs_tokens_test_t: One point per run on the 41 Test-T drugs. Vertical: Tanimoto similarity to the true structure of the first valid answer among up to eight samples (0 if none is valid). Horizontal: tokens generated per answer, all samples drawn up to that answer; prompts are not counted and CPU controls generate none (plotted at 0). The dashed line is the best constant answer (C3, 0.199). Labels mark the best setting of each arm. 1 runs with fewer than eight samples per prompt have no first-valid value and are not shown. One training seed per arm; with 41 drugs, differences of a few hundredths are not resolved.
f2_similarity_vs_tokens_val: One point per run on the 20 Val drugs. Vertical: Tanimoto similarity to the true structure of the first valid answer among up to eight samples (0 if none is valid). Horizontal: tokens generated per answer, all samples drawn up to that answer; prompts are not counted and CPU controls generate none (plotted at 0). The dashed line is the best constant answer (C3, 0.187). Labels mark the best setting of each arm. 7 runs with fewer than eight samples per prompt have no first-valid value and are not shown. One training seed per arm; with 20 drugs, differences of a few hundredths are not resolved.
f3_rl_training: RL pilot runs (R1, R5, R2, R3, R4). Left: Val similarity as the similarity of the first valid answer (solid line; only runs that sampled eight per prompt log it) and as the mean over all samples with invalid answers counted as 0 (dashed line), and the share of valid answers, every 10 steps; circled points are the A2 checkpoint RL starts from, the dashed grey line is the best constant answer. Middle: training reward (the standard reward, also for runs trained on another reward) and batch lift, trailing 5-step mean (faint lines: single steps). Right: collapse score (distinct most-common answers over drugs with a valid answer; alarm below 0.7) and the share of valid answers equal to the most common one.
f4_lift_vs_similarity_test_t: Delivered similarity against lift for each run on the 41 Test-T drugs. Lift is the first valid answer's similarity to its own drug's structure minus its mean similarity to the other drugs' structures: it measures association with the drug, not use of the profile, and is 0 for a constant answer. The nearest-profile copy (C1) has lift +0.014. The RL checkpoints have lift +0.009 to +0.009 at similarity 0.186 to 0.186. The dashed line is the best constant answer (C3, 0.199). 1 runs without first-valid values are not shown.
f4_lift_vs_similarity_val: Delivered similarity against lift for each run on the 20 Val drugs. Lift is the first valid answer's similarity to its own drug's structure minus its mean similarity to the other drugs' structures: it measures association with the drug, not use of the profile, and is 0 for a constant answer. The nearest-profile copy (C1) has lift +0.022. The RL checkpoints have lift +0.003 to +0.016 at similarity 0.149 to 0.195. The dashed line is the best constant answer (C3, 0.187). 7 runs without first-valid values are not shown.
table_test_t: Test-T results of every run: validity, delivered (first-valid) similarity with its cost in samples and tokens per answer, lift, mean similarity, core and exact match.
table_val: Val results of every run: validity, delivered (first-valid) similarity with its cost in samples and tokens per answer, lift, mean similarity, core and exact match.
